verdict.rationale: Password protection for a deployed site is a fair question for a cloud hosting platform like Render, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions basic auth, password-protected sites or previews, or any built-in access gate. Private networking, environment isolation and TLS are adjacent security features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can put simple password protection on a deployed site without standing up a custom auth system
